reviewer: Codex inline, not independent peer review

findings.problem: cached readiness/control_fresh could outlive real completed control/maintenance progress
findings.resolution: absolute minimum of capability expiry, real progress+5s and sample cache; sampling overhead cannot extend deadline
findings.regression: two failed checks before fix, then green: control age and recording overhead

findings.problem: local snapshot reader followed symlinks and could block opening a FIFO
findings.resolution: O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK plus descriptor regular-file check, bounded read, fail closed
findings.regression: symlink RED; actual FIFO in reaped 5s-bounded subprocess

findings.problem: stream-reader close failure skipped notification resource close
findings.resolution: stdlib AsyncExitStack attempts all owned cleanup callbacks and propagates errors
findings.regression: reader-close RED; both health/reader failure branches green
